verdict.rationale: Slack ships an official documented MCP server (docs.slack.dev/ai/slack-mcp-server) exposing tools for search, messaging, canvases, lists, users, and file uploads, and a live hands-on probe confirms a real MCP endpoint (api.slack.com/mcp) responding to JSON-RPC initialize (auth-gated as expected). This is first-party and independently verified via hands-on probing. Missing for 10: no independent third-party community write-up of using the MCP server in production beyond the vendor docs and probe.
